title: Art. 3.8.1 — Annex 9 - Facilitation, Chapter 3 - Entry and Departure of Persons and Their Baggage, C. Security of travel documents, 3.8.1
content: Contracting States shall establish appropriate controls over the entire travel document application, adjudication and issuance processes to ensure a high level of integrity and security.
